ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the left input is X(s), entering the first summing point, and the X(s) terminal is marked with a positive sign. The first summing point also has two feedback inputs, both marked with negative signs: one is fed back from the output of the second summing point, that is, the signal before the final 1/s block; the other is fed back from the final output Y(s). The output of the first summing point is divided to the right into upper and lower paths, passing through two parallel blocks with transfer functions s and 1/s respectively; these two signals are added with positive signs at the second summing point. The output of the second summing point then passes through the last 1/s block to obtain the output Y(s). Then reasoning: Let the output of the first summing point be E(s), and let the output of the second summing point, that is, the signal before the last 1/s block, be U(s). From the parallel branches, U(s)=sE(s)+(1/s)E(s)=(s+1/s)E(s). From the last 1/s block, Y(s)=U(s)/s. From the sign relationship of the first summing point, E(s)=X(s)-U(s)-Y(s). Substituting Y(s)=U(s)/s gives E(s)=X(s)-U(s)-U(s)/s=X(s)-U(s)(1+1/s). Then substituting U(s)=(s+1/s)E(s) gives U(s)=(s+1/s)[X(s)-U(s)(1+1/s)]. Rearranging gives U(s)[1+(s+1/s)(1+1/s)]=(s+1/s)X(s). Therefore U(s)/X(s)=(s+1/s)/[1+(s+1/s)(1+1/s)]. The required H(s)=Y(s)/X(s)=(U(s)/s)/X(s)=[(s+1/s)/s]/[1+(s+1/s)(1+1/s)]. Simplify the denominator: 1+(s+1/s)(1+1/s)=s+2+1/s+1/s^2; the numerator is 1+1/s^2. Multiplying numerator and denominator by s^2 gives H(s)=(s^2+1)/(s^3+2s^2+s+1).

The first summing point also has two feedback inputs, both marked with negative signs: one is fed back from the output of the second summing point, that is, the signal before the final 1/s block; the other is fed back from the final output Y(s). The output of the first summing point is divided to the right into upper and lower paths, passing through two parallel blocks with transfer functions s and 1/s respectively; these two signals are added with positive signs at the second summing point.
